mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notice ( admin_no, notice_category, notice_title, notice_content, notice_content_text, notice_hit, notice_pin_yn, notice_visible_yn, notice_created ) VALUES ( #{adminNo}, #{noticeCategory}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{noticeContentText}, #{noticeHit}, #{noticePinYn}, #{noticeVisibleYn}, #{noticeCreated} )
